# FinOps — guardrails

**Local policy v1, adopted October 10, 2026.**

| ID | Project rule | Checked at |
| --- | --- | --- |
| FIN-02 | Estimate the effect of creating, expanding, or changing paid consumption before acting. Separate estimates, budgets, and observed spend. | plan, run |
| FIN-03 | Define an authorized budget or consumption envelope, duration, and response to deviations before starting a paid execution. | run |
| FIN-04 | Size CPU, memory, storage, replicas, and concurrency against required load and quality. | plan |
